products.name: Creality Pika Portable 3D Scanner, 7-line blue laser + NIR, built-in touchscreen, two swappable batteries
specs: 7 parallel blue laser lines + NIR structured light
Blue laser up to 0.03 mm; NIR up to 0.1 mm
Blue laser up to 110 fps on a PC, 40 fps on a phone; NIR up to 30 fps on a PC, 20 fps on a phone
10 mm to 2,000 mm (0.4 in to 6.5 ft)
Two 3,350 mAh swappable batteries included, up to 70 minutes each (Creality FAQ)
iPhone: iOS 15+, A15 chip, 6 GB RAM. Android: Android 10+, Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, 8 GB RAM
iPhone: A17 chip, 8 GB RAM. Android: Snapdragon 8 Gen 4, 12 GB RAM
Windows 10/11 64-bit, Intel i7 7th gen, NVIDIA GPU with 8 GB VRAM, 16 GB RAM; Mac: macOS 14, Apple M2, 16 GB RAM
USB-C (USB 3.0) or Wi-Fi 6; iPhone connects over Wi-Fi only
Tripod, turntable, 6 marker towers, 10 × 6 mm and 10 × 3 mm markers, glass calibration board, 2 NIR filters, 2 m USB-C cable
products.summary: A 260 g handheld scanner with a 7-line blue laser rated to 0.03 mm and an NIR mode for larger objects. It has a built-in touchscreen and comes with two swappable batteries. It scans from a recent phone, a tablet or a computer.
products.fit: Small, detailed objects such as figures, mechanical parts and props, scanned away from a desk with a recent iPhone (A15 chip and 6 GB RAM or newer) or a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 Android phone.
caveats: It needs a connected phone, tablet or computer for processing. On mid-range phones (Snapdragon 695, Dimensity 900, Exynos 1480), owners report 1 to 3 fps in NIR mode and no blue-laser mode.
Creality says marker-free laser scanning works only in wired PC mode. On a phone, laser scans need the included marker towers or dots.
Black surfaces left holes in NIR mode in one review until the object was dusted with powder. Hair is hard to capture in every mode.
Reviewers say the included turntable wobbles, and test units arrived with flat batteries.
Amazon listings have been priced well above the Creality store (CNX Software saw $899).

products.name: Creality CR-Scan Ferret Pro 3D Scanner, 0.1 mm, with wireless bridge and battery handle
specs: 150 mm to 2 m (6 in to 6.5 ft)
Rechargeable handheld handle, wireless bridge, phone holder, mini tripod, marker dots, carry case
Creality Scan app on Android and iOS phones, Windows and Mac
products.summary: A low-cost handheld scanner rated to 0.1 mm for objects from 6 in to 6.5 ft. The handle, wireless bridge and phone holder in the box let you scan cordless with a phone.
products.fit: Medium to large objects such as busts, helmets, car seats and furniture, scanned with an ordinary phone on a budget under $400.
caveats: Not for small, fine-detail parts: objects under about 6 in are below its range.
Dark, black and translucent objects need scanning spray (one reviewer used dry shampoo).
One reviewer says the handle battery drains quickly and the scanner sometimes loses tracking.
Owner reviews often call the software glitchy.
